subtasks.description: Treat this as one indivisible final-output subtask; do not create an intermediate Model-only analysis task. The final producer must be Agent resource_id agent.fullstack_implementation_engineer.v1, bound to Model resource_id model.qwen3_5_35b_a3b.v1 with API identity qwen3.5-35b-a3b. Inspect the supplied small JSON dataset by calling Tool resource_id tool.mcp.fs_read_file.v1 with capability operation tool.mcp.fs_read_file.v1::read_text_file, receive that Tool result in the same controller session, and apply advisory Skill resource_id skill.superpowers.verification-before-completion.v1 before writing. Produce one concise Markdown evidence note stating that there are 2 rows and the total value is 8, and cite the Tool result.
